lessons.title: Привет!

sentences.english: Hi!
Bye, mum!
Yes, coffee!
No, taxi.
Hi, dad!
Metro, bank, sport, music.

lessons.tip: А К М О Т look and sound like English A K M O T. МАМА is just M-A-M-A, ТАКСИ starts with Т-А-К. Stress is not written: copy the sound you hear.

lessons.title: Polite hellos

sentences.english: Hello! Nice to meet you.
Good morning, mum!
Hi! How are things?
Fine, thanks!
Coffee, please.
Thanks, goodbye!

lessons.tip: В = V, Н = N, Р = R, С = S: they look like English letters but sound different. ВЕЧЕР = V-ye-ch-ye-R, СПАСИБО = S-P-A-S-ee-B-O (П = P, Б = B).

lessons.title: My name is…

items.english: my name is (lit. they call me)

sentences.english: My name is Anna.
What is your name?
Hello! What is your name?
Who is this? It is mum.
Are you Anna? Yes, I am Anna.

sentences.target: Это они: мама, папа. Мы хорошо.
sentences.english: It is them: mum, dad. We are fine.
sentences.translit: Eto oni: mama, papa. My khorosho.

lines.english: Hi, Tom! Nice to meet you.

lessons.tip: No "am / is / are" in the present: Я Анна = "I (am) Anna", Это такси = "this (is) a taxi". Я looks like a backwards R but says "ya".

lessons.title: Where are you from?

sentences.english: I am from America.
Where are you from? I am from Canada.

sentences.target: Он из Англии, она из России.
sentences.english: He is from England, she is from Russia.
sentences.translit: On iz Anglii, ona iz Rossii.

sentences.english: We are from Germany.
Where are you from? We are from Poland.
This is dad. He is from Spain.

lines.english: Fine, thanks! What is your name?
My name is Ivan. Where are you from?

lessons.tip: Я из + country = "I am from". After из the ending shifts (Англия → из Англии): just copy the chunk. И = ee, Я = ya, Е = ye: ИТАЛИЯ = ee-TAH-lee-ya.

lessons.title: What I do

sentences.english: I am a student.
She is a student. She is from Poland.
Dad is a doctor, mum is a teacher.
I am not an engineer. I am a programmer.
I do not understand. Please repeat.

sentences.target: Говорите медленно, пожалуйста! Я не знаю.
sentences.english: Speak slowly, please! I do not know.
sentences.translit: Govorite medlenno, pozhaluysta! Ya ne znayu.

fills.english: I am a student. (a woman speaking)
I do not understand. Speak slowly.

lessons.tip: Add -ка for a woman: студент → студентка. Not = не before the verb: я не знаю = I do not know. Ч = ch, ш = sh; the soft sign Ь (учитель) just softens the л.

lessons.title: Coffee & tea

sentences.english: Tea, please.
Coffee with milk, please.
Tea without sugar.
Water and ice, please.
Is this beer? No, it is wine.
Dad, chocolate? Yes, thanks!

lessons.tip: с + thing = with, без + thing = without: кофе с молоком, чай без сахара (copy the chunks). и = and. Ч = ch, Ш = sh: ЧАЙ = ch-eye, ШОКОЛАД = sho-ko-lad.

lessons.title: Food

sentences.english: Bread and cheese, please.
Soup, salad and tea.
Is this fish? No, it is chicken.
Hi, mum! Cake and coffee!
Meat and potatoes, please.
A burger, ice cream and lemonade, please.

fills.english: Is this fish? No, it is chicken.

lessons.tip: Д = D, З = Z, Б = B, Г = G, Л = L, П = P. Х = kh, like the "ch" in Scottish "loch": ХЛЕБ = khlyeb. Many food words you can already read: пицца, бургер, салат, суп.

lessons.title: Fruit & veg

sentences.english: This is an apple. This is a banana.
An orange, please.
Tomato and cucumber: this is a salad.
Bread, butter and egg.
Rice and pasta, please.
Is this fruit? No, it is vegetables.

fills.english: This is an apple. This is a banana.
Is this vegetables? No, it is fruit.

lines.english: Yes, an orange and an apple, please.

lessons.tip: The ending shows the gender: consonant = he (банан), -а/-я = she (рыба), -о/-е = it (яблоко, яйцо). Plurals often end in -ы/-и: фрукты, овощи, макароны.

lessons.title: At the café

sentences.english: The menu, please.
I want coffee.
May I have tea? Yes, please.
Soup for me, please.
Please give me more tea.
The coffee is hot, the lemonade is cold. Delicious!

fills.english: Excuse me, may I have tea?

lessons.tip: Мне + thing + пожалуйста = "I would like ...". Я хочу = I want, можно = may I. Letters: Щ = shch, Ё = yo: ЕЩЁ = yeh-SHCHYO.

lessons.title: The bill

sentences.english: The bill, please.

sentences.target: Здесь или с собой? С собой, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: Here or to go? To go, please.
sentences.translit: Zdes' ili s soboy? S soboy, pozhaluysta.

sentences.english: I want to pay by card.

sentences.target: Я вегетарианец. У вас есть салат?
sentences.english: I am a vegetarian. Do you have a salad?
sentences.translit: Ya vegetarianets. U vas yest' salat?

sentences.english: Tip and change: thanks!
Enjoy your meal! Everything was delicious!

fills.english: I want to pay by card.
I am a vegetarian. Do you have a salad?

lessons.tip: Ы is a deep "ee" made at the back of the mouth: мы, вы, сыр. Ь softens the letter before it and has no sound: платить (the last Ь is silent). У вас есть = "do you have" (lit. by you there is).

lessons.title: 0 to 10

sentences.english: One coffee, please.

sentences.target: Два чая и три сока, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: Two teas and three juices, please.
sentences.translit: Dva chaya i tri soka, pozhaluysta.

sentences.english: How many? Five.
How much sugar? Zero!
Mum, how many? Eight or nine?
Six, seven, ten! No, nine.

lessons.tip: Ь and Ъ make no sound of their own: ПЯТЬ = pyat, ВОСЕМЬ = VO-syem. After 2, 3, 4 the noun changes a little (два чая, три банана): copy these as chunks for now.

lessons.title: 11 to 40

sentences.english: Tea is thirty, coffee is forty.
How many? Twenty-five.
Eleven, twelve, thirteen.
Fourteen, fifteen, sixteen.
Seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty!

sentences.target: Салат двадцать два, суп тридцать три.
sentences.english: Salad is twenty-two, soup is thirty-three.
sentences.translit: Salat dvadtsat' dva, sup tridtsat' tri.

fills.english: Tea is thirty, coffee is forty.

lessons.tip: -надцать = -teen: один → одиннадцать, пять → пятнадцать, девять → девятнадцать. -дцать = -ty: два → двадцать, три → тридцать. Сорок (40) is just its own word.

lessons.title: 50 to a million

sentences.english: How much is the coffee? Fifty.
Tea is sixty, cake is seventy.
Salad is eighty, soup is ninety.
A hundred! Two hundred, three hundred!
How much is the pizza? Five hundred.
A thousand! A million! No, a hundred.

fills.english: Tea is sixty, cake is seventy.
A hundred, two hundred, three hundred.

lines.english: Good day! How much is the pizza?
The pizza is five hundred. Okay?

lessons.tip: -десят marks the tens: пять-десят = 5 x 10. Hundreds end in -ста / -сти: двести, триста. Девяносто (90) and сто (100) are the odd ones, just learn them.

lessons.title: Money talk

sentences.target: Один рубль, два рубля, пять рублей.
sentences.english: One rouble, two roubles, five roubles.
sentences.translit: Odin rubl', dva rublya, pyat' rubley.

sentences.english: How much is the coffee? A hundred roubles.
Too expensive! The tea is cheap.
Do you have a discount?
The price: twenty euros. Is that all?
Money? No, I am a student!

lines.english: Coffee is a hundred roubles. Okay?
There is a discount: eighty roubles. Okay?

lessons.tip: 1 рубль, 2-4 рубля, 5+ рублей: learn each as a chunk, no maths needed. Ё = yo and stress matter: ДЁШЕВО = DYO-she-vo, ЕВРО = YEV-ro.

lessons.title: Shopping basics

example.english: This is a market. It is open!

sentences.english: This is a shop. It is open!
The market? No, it is closed.
The till, please. A bag and a receipt.
I will take this. How much is it?
Please show me. Is there another colour?
Out of stock. Sorry!

fills.english: The market? No, it is closed.
A bag and a receipt, please.

lines.english: No, thanks. I will take this.

lessons.tip: открыто / закрыто = open / closed ("it is open"). Нет в наличии = not in stock. A question is just a statement said with rising voice: Есть чек? = Is there a receipt?

lessons.title: Where?

sentences.english: Where is the metro? Here.
Where is the bank? There, to the left.
Where is the market? To the right, straight on.
Is the shop far? No, it is close.
Is there a cash machine nearby?
Taxi, over there, please. This way!

fills.english: The cash machine is to the right.

lessons.tip: где = where. Just say Где + thing: Где метро? Здесь = here, там = there. Туда / сюда mean "to there / to here" (with movement). In ЗДЕСЬ the Д is nearly silent: zdyes.

lessons.title: Places

sentences.english: Where is the station? Straight on.
The airport is far, the station is close.
Excuse me, where is the toilet? There, to the left.

sentences.target: Это музей. Это парк. Это мост.
sentences.english: This is a museum. This is a park. This is a bridge.
sentences.translit: Eto muzey. Eto park. Eto most.

sentences.english: The hotel is nearby, the square is close.
Excuse me, where is the church? It is there.

fills.english: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
The airport is far, the station is close.
This is a museum. This is not a park.
Where is the pharmacy? To the left.

lines.english: Excuse me, where is the station?
The station? Straight on, to the left.
The toilet? There. Is that all?

lessons.tip: Stress changes how a vowel sounds: an unstressed О sounds like "a", so АПТЕКА = ap-TYE-ka and ВОКЗАЛ = vak-ZAL. Stress is not written, so learn each word with its sound.

lessons.title: Transport

sentences.english: Bus, tram, metro: where is the stop?

sentences.target: Я на автобусе. Он на метро.
sentences.english: I am on the bus. He is on the metro.
sentences.translit: Ya na avtobuse. On na metro.

sentences.english: The train is close, the plane is far.
A car? A bike? No, on foot!
A ticket, please. How much is the ticket?
A traffic jam! The minibus is here.

fills.english: I am on the bus. He is on the metro.

lines.english: Hi! Are you on the bus?
No, on foot. A traffic jam!

lessons.tip: на + vehicle = "by / on": на автобусе, на трамвае, на метро (the ending changes to -е, just copy the chunk). No vehicle at all: пешком = on foot.

lessons.title: Asking the way

items.english: how do I get to (on foot)

example.english: How do I get to the station?

items.english: how do I get to (by transport)
is it far? / it is far

example.english: I need to go to the airport.

sentences.english: Could you tell me where the pharmacy is?
How do I get to the station?
How do I get to the station (by transport)?

sentences.target: Я потерялся! Покажите на карте, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: I am lost! Show me on the map, please.
sentences.translit: Ya poteryalsya! Pokazhite na karte, pozhaluysta.

sentences.english: Is it far? How many minutes?

sentences.target: Мне нужно в аэропорт. Остановитесь здесь, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: I need to go to the airport. Stop here, please.
sentences.translit: Mne nuzhno v aeroport. Ostanovites' zdes', pozhaluysta.

fills.english: Could you tell me where the bank is?
I am lost! Show me on the map.
Is it far? How many minutes?
I need to go to the airport.

lines.target: Извините, вы не подскажете, где вокзал?
lines.english: Excuse me, could you tell me where the station is?
lines.translit: Izvinite, vy ne podskazhete, gde vokzal?

lines.english: The station? It is far. To the left, straight on.
Show me on the map, please.

lessons.tip: Как пройти...? = how do I get (on foot) to...? Как доехать...? = by transport. Soften any question with Вы не подскажете...? = could you tell me...? Say the place right after: Как пройти на вокзал?

lessons.title: Tickets & stations

sentences.english: One ticket, please.

sentences.target: Один билет туда и обратно, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: One return ticket, please.
sentences.translit: Odin bilet tuda i obratno, pozhaluysta.

sentences.english: What time does the train leave?
This is the timetable: departure, arrival.
Passport, visa, luggage: that is all.
The change is close. The delay is twenty minutes.

fills.english: What time does the train leave?
This is the timetable: departure, arrival.

lines.target: Да, один билет туда и обратно.
lines.translit: Da, odin bilet tuda i obratno.

lessons.tip: туда и обратно = "there and back" = return ticket. Во сколько? = at what time? Perfect for stations: Во сколько отходит поезд? Words ending in -ие (отправление, прибытие, расписание) are all "it".

units.title: I want / I have / I need

lessons.title: I want

items.english: I am thirsty / want to drink
I am hungry / want to eat
I am sleepy / want to sleep

example.english: I want to buy a ticket.

items.english: I want to look at / watch

sentences.english: I am thirsty.
Are you hungry?
I do not want to sleep.
I want to buy a ticket.

sentences.target: Я хочу посмотреть парк. Хочу увидеть мост.
sentences.english: I want to look at the park. I want to see the bridge.
sentences.translit: Ya khochu posmotret' park. Khochu uvidet' most.

sentences.english: Bye, I want to go home!

fills.english: I want to drink. Tea, please.
I do not want to sleep. Coffee!
I want to buy a ticket.

lines.english: No, I want something to drink.

lessons.tip: хочу + infinitive: хочу пить = "I want (to) drink" = I am thirsty. Infinitives often end in -ть: пить, спать, купить. To say no: я не хочу.

lessons.title: I have

items.english: what do you have / what is up

sentences.english: I have a phone.
I do not have a key.
Do you have a bag?

sentences.target: У него есть машина, у неё есть велосипед.
sentences.english: He has a car, she has a bike.
sentences.translit: U nevo yest' mashina, u neyo yest' velosiped.

sentences.target: У нас есть билет. У них нет паспорта.
sentences.english: We have a ticket. They do not have a passport.
sentences.translit: U nas yest' bilet. U nikh net pasporta.

sentences.target: Что у тебя? У меня проблема!
sentences.english: What is up? I have a problem!
sentences.translit: Shto u tebya? U menya problema!

fills.english: I do not have a key.

lines.english: I have a bag and a phone.

lessons.tip: У меня есть = "I have" (literally "by me there is"). У меня нет = "I do not have": after нет the noun changes (ключ → ключа). Learn the У + person chunks: у меня, у тебя, у него, у неё, у нас, у них.

lessons.title: I need

sentences.target: Мне нужен билет. Мне нужна карта.
sentences.english: I need a ticket. I need a map.
sentences.translit: Mne nuzhen bilet. Mne nuzhna karta.

sentences.english: I need help! Urgently!
I really need coffee!
Not now. Please wait.
One moment! I have time.
Can we do it a bit later? Okay, fine.

fills.english: You cannot do that here. Sorry.

lessons.tip: Мне нужно + infinitive: мне нужно платить. With a noun, нужен / нужна follows the noun's gender: нужен билет (he), нужна карта (she). Нельзя = not allowed, ладно = fine.

lessons.title: I can

items.english: I do not know how to

sentences.english: I can pay by card.
I cannot. Sorry.
Can you? Of course!
Can you help? Of course.

sentences.target: Я умею пить кофе. Я не умею спать.
sentences.english: I know how to drink coffee. I do not know how to sleep.
sentences.translit: Ya umeyu pit' kofe. Ya ne umeyu spat'.

sentences.english: Will it work? Come on! Deal.

lines.english: Of course! What do you need?
I need a map. Is now okay?

lessons.tip: Я могу = I can, ты можешь, вы можете: it is irregular, but these are the only forms you need now. Я умею = I know how to (a skill). Договорились! = deal!

lessons.title: Emergencies

sentences.target: Я не говорю по-русски. Вы говорите по-английски?
sentences.english: I do not speak Russian. Do you speak English?
sentences.translit: Ya ne govoryu po-russki. Vy govorite po-angliyski?

sentences.english: What does this mean? How do you say it?
Help! I feel unwell!
Call a doctor, please! The police!
I lost my passport. My phone was stolen!
Everything is fine. No big deal.

fills.english: Everything is fine. No big deal.

lines.english: Good day! What is the problem?

lessons.tip: Plain не before a verb makes it negative: я не понимаю, я не говорю по-русски. Learn the emergency words whole: Помогите! Полиция! Вызовите врача!
